title: Design System: Jiaming Zhang Working Folio

display.purpose: Reliability-led homepage thesis and project titles.

motion.name: trace-draw
motion.purpose: Draw the single hero underline from an already-visible composition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Resolve motion immediately while preserving the final state.

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: A compact title with a same-row dashed leader.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:0; color:var(--ink); font:500 19px/1.2 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-section-heading span { flex:none; } .ds-section-heading i { flex:1; border-top:1px dashed var(--line-strong); }

components.name: Work Index Link
components.description: An unboxed project route with summary, period, and directional response.
components.html: VivoFlowFrom fragmented workflows to a company-wide source of truth.2025–Present
components.css: .ds-work-link { --row-bleed:14px; --row-overflow:54px; --arrow-slot:40px; position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 112px; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-right:calc(var(--row-overflow) * -1); margin-left:calc(var(--row-bleed) * -1); padding:14px var(--row-overflow) 15px var(--row-bleed); border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; } .ds-work-link::before { position:absolute; inset:0 var(--arrow-slot) 0 0; border-radius:12px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 24%,transparent); content:""; opacity:0; transition:opacity 160ms ease; } .ds-work-link:hover::before,.ds-work-link:focus-visible::before { opacity:1; } .ds-work-copy,.ds-work-meta,.ds-work-arrow { position:relative; z-index:1; } .ds-work-copy strong,.ds-work-copy small { display:block; } .ds-work-copy strong { font:500 20px/1.3 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-work-copy small,.ds-work-meta { color:var(--ink-soft); font:400 14px/1.45 Georgia,serif; } .ds-work-copy small { margin-top:3px; } .ds-work-meta { justify-self:end; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-work-arrow { position:absolute; right:8px; display:flex; color:var(--ink-soft); opacity:0; transform:translateX(-6px); transition:opacity 160ms ease,transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-work-arrow svg { width:24px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-work-link:hover .ds-work-arrow,.ds-work-link:focus-visible .ds-work-arrow { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } .ds-work-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Experience Row
components.description: A non-interactive experience entry with an authored hover wash and responsive reading order.
components.css: .ds-experience-row { --row-bleed:14px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1.25fr .85fr; gap:22px; margin-inline:calc(var(--row-bleed) * -1); padding:6px var(--row-bleed); border-radius:12px; font:400 15px/1.5 Georgia,serif; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-experience-row:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 24%,transparent); } .ds-experience-row strong { font:450 16px/1.5 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-experience-row span,.ds-experience-row time { color:var(--ink-soft); } .ds-experience-row time { text-align:right; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-experience-row { --row-bleed:10px; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:2px 16px; padding-top:9px; padding-bottom:9px; } .ds-experience-row span { grid-column:1 / -1; grid-row:2; } .ds-experience-row time { grid-column:2; grid-row:1; } }

components.name: Stack Tool
components.description: A bare brand-mark target with a compact inverse tooltip.
components.css: .ds-stack-tool { position:relative; display:grid; width:32px; height:32px; place-items:center; color:var(--ink); } .ds-stack-tool svg { width:23px; height:23px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; opacity:.78; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity 180ms ease; } .ds-stack-tool::after { position:absolute; bottom:calc(100% + 9px); left:50%; padding:4px 7px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); content:attr(data-label); font:450 11px/1.35 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transform:translate(-50%,4px); transition:150ms ease; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-stack-tool:hover svg,.ds-stack-tool:focus-visible svg { opacity:1; transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(-2deg); } .ds-stack-tool:hover::after,.ds-stack-tool:focus-visible::after { opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0); } .ds-stack-tool:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Contact Link
components.description: A compact accessible icon link with the same authored micro-response as Stack.
components.css: .ds-contact-link { position:relative; display:block; width:25px; height:25px; color:var(--ink); } .ds-contact-link svg { width:25px; height:25px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; stroke-width:1.35; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-contact-link:hover svg,.ds-contact-link:focus-visible svg { transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(-2deg); } .ds-contact-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Concept Figure
components.description: A public-safe explanation drawn directly on the paper field.
components.css: .ds-concept { margin:0; padding:42px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); } .ds-node { display:flex; min-height:124px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--ink-soft); border-radius:52% 48% 50% 46%; text-align:center; transform:rotate(-1deg); } .ds-node strong { font:500 20px/1.2 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-node small,.ds-concept figcaption { color:var(--ink-faint); font:400 12px/1.5 Georgia,serif; } .ds-concept figcaption { margin-top:36px; }

narrative.overview: The system feels like a considered personal document that remains in use: warm paper, softened graphite, literary reading type, and a few precise hand-drawn gestures. It presents real engineering work with calm confidence, without turning the person into a conversion funnel or the page into a résumé template. Expression comes from typography, whitespace, dotted rules, and restrained linework. The interface stays quiet enough for long-form reading, while slightly irregular strokes and organic conceptual diagrams keep it authored rather than institutional. It rejects ornamental scrapbook nostalgia, card grids, and decorative texture.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper field with softened graphite hierarchy.
Modern structural sans paired with a literary serif reading voice.
Slightly left-offset reading rhythm with wider directory and figure moments.
Sparse dashed rules, organic geometry, and one purposeful drawn-line motion.
Public-safe, evidence-led project storytelling without screenshots or invented proof.

rules.name: The Paper Field Rule
rules.body: The warm paper is the continuous canvas; do not break reading flow with white cards or tinted panels.

rules.name: The Graphite Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and tone, never pure black or a speculative accent color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans structures and directs; serif explains and reflects. Do not introduce monospace or handwriting as a third general-purpose voice.

rules.name: The Quiet Weight Rule
rules.body: Prefer medium and variable weights over blunt boldness; emphasis should feel written into the hierarchy, not applied as decoration.

rules.name: The Reading Axis Rule
rules.body: Prose stays narrow; directories and evidence may widen only when the additional width improves scanning or comprehension.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Do not lift sections into cards. A new surface must justify its existence through content hierarchy, not elevation.

rules.name: The Meaningful Irregularity Rule
rules.body: Hand-drawn variation belongs to lines and conceptual geometry that explain something; never add doodles merely to decorate empty space.

dos: Do keep the warm paper field continuous and the primary text softened from pure black.
Do use typography, whitespace, measure, and sparse rules as the main hierarchy tools.
Do keep long-form prose narrow while allowing public-safe diagrams to widen.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, readable small-text contrast, and an immediate reduced-motion alternative.
Do use conceptual diagrams only when they communicate confirmed, public-safe facts.
donts: Don't introduce cards, persistent navigation, hero CTAs, technology tag walls, or résumé-conversion patterns.
Don't add tape, torn edges, sticky notes, paper fibers, pervasive doodles, or reconstructed screenshots.
Don't use pure black, bright accent colors, gradients, decorative shadows, or ornamental texture.
Don't fabricate imagery, metrics, evidence, or confidential interface detail to make a case study feel complete.
Don't publish placeholder sections or assets; omit unfinished material until the real content exists.
